opportunities.name: AWS Activate Founders
opportunities.summary: Cloud credits for eligible self-funded startups, including eligible Bedrock usage.
opportunities.eligibility: Self-funded; founded in the last ten years; working website; new to Activate.
opportunities.limits: Select startups may qualify for up to US$5,000. Country eligibility and award terms need checking.

opportunities.name: AWS Activate Portfolio
opportunities.summary: Cloud credit for provider-backed startups; eligible Bedrock models are covered.
opportunities.eligibility: Pre-Series B; founded in the last ten years; an Activate Provider organisation ID is required.
opportunities.limits: Prior awards affect the available amount; invitation-only AI credits are separate. Check country, service and expiry terms.

opportunities.name: Google Cloud Start
opportunities.summary: Entry-level Google Cloud credits for early-stage startups.
opportunities.eligibility: Working MVP, business model and plans to seek venture funding; subject to review.
opportunities.limits: The Start tier is distinct from funded Scale tiers. Credits cover eligible Google services, not third-party Marketplace models.

opportunities.name: Google Cloud Scale AI
opportunities.value: Up to US$350,000 over two years
opportunities.summary: Credit for qualifying venture-funded AI-first startups using Google Cloud.
opportunities.eligibility: Qualifying venture funding, company age and prior credit limits apply.
opportunities.limits: Year one covers eligible usage up to $250K; year two covers 20% of spend up to $100K. Third-party model credits are separate.

opportunities.name: Microsoft for Startups
opportunities.summary: Azure credits and startup support with additional milestones.
opportunities.eligibility: Privately held, for-profit software product startup before Series C; country and business verification apply.
opportunities.limits: Higher amounts have workload, usage or investor conditions. Only eligible models sold and billed by Azure are covered; third-party-billed models can be excluded.

opportunities.name: Oracle Cloud Free Trial
opportunities.summary: OCI trial and limited Always Free services.
opportunities.eligibility: New eligible trial customers; card verification required.
opportunities.limits: Trial credit is not verified as unrestricted generative AI inference credit. Trial and Always Free limits differ.

opportunities.name: OpenAI for Startups
opportunities.summary: API credits may be available through participating VC partners.
opportunities.eligibility: Qualifying VC relationship and referral process; ask the provider or your investor.
opportunities.limits: No universal public amount established; an Australian partnership announcement is historical and does not prove current award terms.

opportunities.name: Claude for Startups
opportunities.value: Up to US$100,000 via partner VC
opportunities.summary: A partner-backed route to additional first-party Claude API credits.
opportunities.eligibility: VC partner affiliation for the larger award.
opportunities.limits: The research recorded the public startup cohort as full; verify current intake. Credits do not transfer to Bedrock or Vertex AI.

opportunities.name: xAI Startups
opportunities.summary: A discretionary API credit programme for qualifying startups.
opportunities.eligibility: Venture backing, live product and a company-domain email.
opportunities.limits: No fixed public maximum; grant and expiry terms are specified by the award.

opportunities.name: Alibaba Cloud AI Catalyst
opportunities.summary: Selected AI startups may receive Model Studio tokens and cloud benefits.
opportunities.eligibility: Selection and service-specific conditions apply.
opportunities.limits: The headline cloud credit and token offer are conditional; verify country, currency, model scope and current campaign terms.

opportunities.name: BytePlus VStart
opportunities.summary: Cloud coupons and selected AI benefits for qualifying startups.
opportunities.eligibility: Round D or earlier and programme selection criteria.
opportunities.limits: The published headline benefits may overlap. Confirm model coverage, expiry and geographic eligibility.

opportunities.name: NVIDIA Inception
opportunities.summary: A no-equity startup programme with technical resources and partner offers.
opportunities.eligibility: Australian page specifies incorporation, less than ten years, a working website and at least one developer.
opportunities.limits: Partner offers have their own eligibility tests. Membership does not imply a specific OpenAI or Claude grant.

opportunities.name: Together AI Startup Accelerator
opportunities.summary: Inference and compute credit tiers for selected startups.
opportunities.eligibility: Award tiers depend on funding raised; programme approval required.
opportunities.limits: Service exclusions apply. Confirm country eligibility and expiry in the award.

opportunities.name: Baseten Startup Program
opportunities.summary: Dedicated inference/training and separate Model API credits for eligible AI startups.
opportunities.eligibility: AI-first, VC-backed Seed–Series A, under five years, with prior-credit and paid-plan restrictions.
opportunities.limits: The published components have different service scopes; six-month expiry. Check country eligibility.

opportunities.name: DeepInfra DeepStart
opportunities.summary: Inference credits for qualifying early-stage startups.
opportunities.eligibility: Direct route specifies company age and funding thresholds; an NVIDIA Inception route has different conditions.
opportunities.limits: The 50-billion-token headline is price-dependent, not 50 billion tokens on every model. One grant per company.

opportunities.name: Modal for Startups
opportunities.summary: GPU compute credits for selected startups.
opportunities.eligibility: New customer and funding or partner conditions vary by tier.
opportunities.limits: Amount, expiry and country eligibility need confirmation. The free Starter plan is separate.

opportunities.name: Cerebras Early Access
opportunities.summary: Selected early-access applicants may receive free credits.
opportunities.eligibility: Apply for early access; selection applies.
opportunities.limits: The separate trial has its own amount and conditions; do not assume a specific startup award.

opportunities.name: Fireworks Startup Program
opportunities.summary: Startup Build Credits for AI inference and related services.
opportunities.eligibility: Programme admission and current terms should be checked.
opportunities.limits: The current public landing page does not establish a single award amount or term.

opportunities.name: Nebius for Startups
opportunities.summary: Startup support through eligible venture-capital partners.
opportunities.eligibility: Current research indicates a VC-partner route and at least US$5M raised.
opportunities.limits: Older promotional awards do not establish a current grant. Confirm amount, country and expiry.

opportunities.name: Devin for Startups
opportunities.summary: Initial credit after approval, with additional matched credits available.
opportunities.eligibility: Application and approval; confirm country, currency and award expiry.
opportunities.limits: The maximum US$65K headline includes up to US$50K in 1:1 matched credits, which requires US$50K of customer spending to unlock fully.

opportunities.name: GitHub for Startups
opportunities.summary: Credits for eligible GitHub Enterprise Cloud products, including Copilot.
opportunities.eligibility: Approved partner and outside funding; at or before Series B; other prior-use restrictions apply.
opportunities.limits: A payment method and paid billing after expiry or exhaustion may apply. Check the full award terms.

opportunities.name: Vercel Startup Program
opportunities.summary: Credits for qualifying venture-backed startups using Vercel.
opportunities.eligibility: Approved partner, funding stage and recency, and prior-grant restrictions apply.
opportunities.limits: Newer awards may cover AI Gateway and v0 subject to caps; up to half can fund Gateway, with a monthly limit.

opportunities.name: Replit for Startups
opportunities.summary: Platform credit and a Pro offer advertised through partner channels.
opportunities.eligibility: VC backing and partner-specific terms apply.
opportunities.limits: The verified partner offer is for new customers and has a six-month term; confirm the current programme details.

opportunities.name: Airtree Frontier
opportunities.summary: Founder residency for people with an Australia or New Zealand connection.
opportunities.eligibility: Includes solo and early founders; subject to selection and investment documentation.
opportunities.limits: An uncapped, no-discount MFN SAFE creates future equity rights. Credits are advertised but specific providers and amounts are not confirmed.

opportunities.name: Blackbird Giants
opportunities.summary: Founder programme for early startup ideas with an ANZ connection.
opportunities.eligibility: Idea under two years and at least one ANZ-connected founder; other exclusions apply.
opportunities.limits: The last researched cohort was a waitlist. Community participation does not establish portfolio status or provider credits.

opportunities.name: Blackbird Foundry
opportunities.summary: An eight-week programme for science and frontier technology teams.
opportunities.eligibility: At least one Australian or New Zealander on the team, application and selection.
opportunities.limits: Hybrid participation; published prize and support terms may change. A specific AI-credit entitlement was not verified.

opportunities.name: Antler Australia Residency
opportunities.summary: Full-time residency and a possible pre-seed investment decision.
opportunities.eligibility: Australian residency, selection and co-founder requirements apply; programme admission does not guarantee investment.
opportunities.limits: Previously published terms included a programme fee and equity. Reconfirm terms and cohort dates directly.

opportunities.name: Startmate Accelerator
opportunities.summary: A founder accelerator for startups with an ANZ connection.
opportunities.eligibility: At least one full-time founder; programme and investor selection apply.
opportunities.limits: Research recorded the Summer 2027 deadline as passed on 8 November 2026. SAFE and travel terms should be verified for any future cohort.

opportunities.name: EWOR Fellowship
opportunities.summary: Virtual-first fellowship for founders at idea or traction stage.
opportunities.eligibility: Global applicants; selection and differing Ideation or Traction terms.
opportunities.limits: Investment and equity economics are substantial and vary by track. No fixed AI credit entitlement verified.

opportunities.name: Z Fellows
opportunities.summary: Worldwide applicants can participate without taking investment.
opportunities.eligibility: Founder selection; a company or co-founder is not required.
opportunities.limits: Mostly virtual with a final day in San Francisco or New York; optional investment is separate. Confirm the current cohort and travel requirements.

opportunities.name: Vercel AI Accelerator
opportunities.summary: A six-week accelerator for early AI products.
opportunities.eligibility: Global pre-seed teams and Vercel customer requirements; selection applies.
opportunities.limits: Previous cohort advertised Anthropic and OpenAI credits. No next intake or future allocation was confirmed.

opportunities.name: On Deck Founder Fellowship
opportunities.summary: A founder community open to international applicants.
opportunities.eligibility: Best suited to venture-scale founders targeting US customers; selection applies.
opportunities.limits: Five days in San Francisco are required; a contribution and travel costs may apply. Dates conflict across sources; confirm before applying.

opportunities.name: South Park Commons
opportunities.summary: Member residency and a separate funded fellowship are distinct routes.
opportunities.eligibility: Members generally work from San Francisco, New York or Bangalore; application and selection required.
opportunities.limits: The residency is no-fee and no-equity; fellowship investment has separate SAFE terms. Verify location and current intake.

opportunities.name: Founders Inc
opportunities.summary: Technical-founder investment programme based in San Francisco.
opportunities.eligibility: International and solo founders may apply; in-person full-time participation and selection apply.
opportunities.limits: Confirm the programme pathway, intake and current investment terms; travel and living costs are separate.

opportunities.name: STATION F
opportunities.summary: Several different startup programmes and workspace options are listed.
opportunities.eligibility: Programme-specific selection and local attendance requirements.
opportunities.limits: Published information about the Founders Program conflicts; fees, equity and intake need direct confirmation.

opportunities.name: StartX
opportunities.summary: Founder programme with specific Stanford affiliation or recommendation requirements.
opportunities.eligibility: Qualifying Stanford-affiliated founder or the Visiting Founders recommendation route.
opportunities.limits: The ordinary application currently points to a future cycle. Specific AI-credit access is not established.

opportunities.name: Google Accelerator: Australia & New Zealand
opportunities.summary: A ten-week programme for AI/ML startups based in Australia or New Zealand.
opportunities.eligibility: Seed to Series A or equivalent and programme-specific selection.
opportunities.limits: Cloud credits require a separate application and approval. Check current intake and participation requirements.

opportunities.name: Google Accelerator: India
opportunities.summary: A hybrid accelerator for India-based AI-first startups.
opportunities.eligibility: Seed to Series A, India-based, building core AI applications.
opportunities.limits: The listed 2026 application deadline has passed; check for a new cohort. Credit eligibility is separate.

opportunities.name: Google Accelerator: Korea
opportunities.summary: A hybrid accelerator for Korean AI-driven startups.
opportunities.eligibility: Korea-based Seed–Series A startups with traction and technical participation.
opportunities.limits: The listed 2026 cohort has finished; confirm the next intake. Product credits have separate eligibility.

opportunities.name: Google Accelerator: Japan
opportunities.summary: Mentorship and workshops for Japanese technology startups.
opportunities.eligibility: Japanese growth-stage startups; check current cohort criteria.
opportunities.limits: The accelerator is support, not a confirmed cash or AI-credit award.

opportunities.name: Google Accelerator: Brazil
opportunities.summary: Technical support for AI-focused startups based in Brazil.
opportunities.eligibility: Brazil-based Seed–Series A startups and programme selection.
opportunities.limits: The programme description does not establish a universal credit grant. Check the current cohort.

opportunities.name: Google Accelerator: South Africa
opportunities.summary: Hybrid support for South African-led growth-stage technology startups.
opportunities.eligibility: Growth-stage, revenue-generating South African-led startups; selection applies.
opportunities.limits: Confirm the current intake and any separate product-credit eligibility.

opportunities.name: Google Accelerator: Singapore
opportunities.summary: Support for Singapore-based startups building generative AI.
opportunities.eligibility: Seed to Series B and programme-specific selection.
opportunities.limits: The directory describes programme focus but does not establish a fixed credit award or current intake.

opportunities.name: Innovate UK funding finder
opportunities.summary: Find current government-backed innovation competitions for UK-based organisations.
opportunities.eligibility: Eligibility and funding depend on each competition.
opportunities.limits: A funding directory, not a guaranteed grant or AI credit.

opportunities.name: Australian grants and programs finder
opportunities.summary: Search government grants, mentoring and other support by location and business need.
opportunities.eligibility: Each programme has its own business and location criteria.
opportunities.limits: A funding directory, not a guaranteed grant or AI credit.

opportunities.name: CSIRO Kick-Start
opportunities.summary: Research funding and CSIRO expertise for eligible Australian startups and SMEs.
opportunities.eligibility: ACN or ICN, GST registration and turnover/expenditure or trading-age criteria; cash contribution required.
opportunities.limits: Matched research funding, not unrestricted cloud or model credit.

opportunities.name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
opportunities.summary: Funding for proof of concept, prototype development, trials and market entry.
opportunities.eligibility: DPIIT-recognised startups and incubator-specific requirements.
opportunities.limits: Funding route and terms vary by incubator; confirm whether applications are currently open.

opportunities.name: Blackbird investment
opportunities.summary: A venture investment route for founders with an ANZ connection.
opportunities.eligibility: Applications and investment are assessed individually, including pre-product and pre-revenue founders.
opportunities.limits: Investment terms are negotiated. A community relationship does not establish portfolio status or a credit award.

opportunities.name: Square Peg investment
opportunities.summary: An investment route for technology founders with an ANZ connection.
opportunities.eligibility: The firm considers early-stage technology companies and accepts founder enquiries.
opportunities.limits: Equity is negotiated; provider-credit access depends on the qualifying relationship and current partner rules.

opportunities.name: Carthona Capital investment
opportunities.summary: A pre-seed to Series A investment route.
opportunities.eligibility: Founder pitch and investment diligence; selection applies.
opportunities.limits: This is a fundraising route, not a membership. No specific AI-credit award was verified.

opportunities.name: Side Stage Ventures investment
opportunities.summary: An Australian pre-seed and seed investment route.
opportunities.eligibility: Application and investment diligence; often suitable for pre-revenue companies.
opportunities.limits: Investment terms vary; no specific AI-credit entitlement was verified.

opportunities.name: Entrepreneur First
opportunities.summary: A founder-selection programme that helps people find co-founders and build companies.
opportunities.eligibility: The London programme accepts international applicants who can relocate; selection and investment decisions are separate.
opportunities.limits: London and San Francisco participation and programme-specific equity terms apply. Confirm the current cohort and visa requirements.

opportunities.name: AI Grant startup programme
opportunities.summary: An AI startup programme that has advertised SAFE investment.
opportunities.eligibility: Programme and investment selection; review the applicable location and terms.
opportunities.limits: The researched startup batch was closed. A separate open-source programme has different terms and no verified current application mechanism.
